anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a large radius visible at the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated pixel length with a high aspect ratio relative to base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ventral counter-shading and bilateral pectoral fins with sharp trailing edge vertices.
